profile.reading: This OpenStreetMap point, labeled Mozoilo AJVP with operator Mozoilo, is located in Galdakao, in the Basque Country region of Spain. Despite the data center style tagging in source data, this registrys research this session found no evidence connecting the name Mozoilo to any computing, colocation, or data center business anywhere. Extensive searching across English, Spanish, and Basque language sources turned up only two unrelated matches for the name Mozoilo in this area: a now inactive real estate agency called Inmobiliaria Mozoilo SL, previously registered in Galdakao, and an unrelated local Basque cultural festival and radio program called Mozoilo Eguna and Mozoilo Irratia. Neither connects in any way to data center infrastructure, and the AJVP portion of the facility name could not be matched to any known company or facility naming convention. This registry records this honestly as an unverifiable or likely mistagged point rather than fabricating a data center profile for it; it may represent a mapping error in the underlying source data, misattributing an unrelated local business or landmark as a data center facility.

reading.body:
A point mapped as a data center in Galdakao, Spain, has no verifiable connection to any computing or colocation business.

The record carries a name, Mozoilo AJVP, and an operator, Mozoilo, but research across English, Spanish, and Basque sources found no data center, computing company, or facility using that name. The only matches in the area are a defunct real estate agency, Inmobiliaria Mozoilo SL, and a local cultural festival and radio program, Mozoilo Eguna and Mozoilo Irratia. Neither relates to data center infrastructure, and the AJVP suffix matches no known naming convention.

For AI specifically, the useful signal is negative. A facility counted in a data center registry is not necessarily a facility that consumes power or houses compute. Registries built from volunteered geographic data inherit the errors of their sources, and a single mistagged point can inflate a count of sites without adding a single megawatt of load.

What this does not establish is that no data center exists in Galdakao. It establishes only that this particular point could not be verified, and that the name attached to it traces to unrelated local businesses. The record sits 4.5 miles from Bilbao Airport, which is a location fact and nothing more. No power, capacity, or grid connection data is present here, so nothing can be said about this site's relationship to the grid constraint.
